senses.gloss: pr. n. m.Romulus, the legendary founder of Rome in conjunction with his brother Remus.
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 10:8">Midr. Till. to Ps. X</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 68:6">Ps. LXVIII, 6</cite>, a.

<cite ref="Psalms 10:14">X, 14</cite>) <he>רומוס ור׳ מתה אמם וכ׳</he> the mother of Remus and Romulus was dead, and a she-wolf was appointed (by Providence) to give them suck, and they built two large huts in Rome; Yalk. ib. 652.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 1:2:8">Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39ᶜ</cite> <he>רומס ורומילס</he>, v. <cite ref="R00780"><he>צְרִיף</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 17:11">Midr. Till. to Ps. XVII, 14</cite>, <he>אלו שני יתומין … רומוס ור׳ וכ׳</he> (not <he>ורימילוס</he>) this refers to the two orphans …, R. and R. for whom thou didst appoint a wolf &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 671:5">Yalk. ib. 671</cite>; <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 3:2">Esth. R. to I, 9</cite> <he>רומוס ורמילוס</he>.
